name: networkwizard
description: Chrome DevTools extension to review, block, override, and delay network calls

scripts.package: v=$(node -p "require('./manifest.json').version") && out="../networkwizard-$v.zip" && rm -f "$out" && zip -rq "$out" manifest.json background.js devtools.html devtools.js panel icons/icon16.png icons/icon48.png icons/icon128.png && echo "packaged $(cd .. && pwd)/networkwizard-$v.zip"
